# supabase_custom_hostname (Resource)

Custom hostname for a Supabase project. The Management API marks this feature as beta.

A project has one custom hostname. See the [custom domains guide](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/custom-domains).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "supabase_custom_hostname" "example" {
  project_ref     = "mayuaycdtijbctgqbycg"
  custom_hostname = "api.example.com"

  # After apply, create these DNS records, then set activate = true:
  # - CNAME custom_hostname -> custom_origin_server
  # - TXT ownership_verification.name -> ownership_verification.value
  # - TXT ssl.validation_records[*].txt_name -> ssl.validation_records[*].txt_value
  #
  # activate = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_hostname` (String) Hostname to serve the project from, such as `api.example.com`. Supabase custom domains support subdomains. Changing it re-initializes the hostname.
- `project_ref` (String) Project reference ID

### Optional

- `activate` (Boolean) When true, the provider reverifies DNS and activates the hostname. Apply again while DNS propagates; the provider keeps planning an update until `status` is `5_services_reconfigured`. Setting this to false leaves an active hostname in place. Delete the resource to remove it. initialize, reverify, and delete allow 10 requests per minute. Each apply sends at most one request to each of those endpoints. See https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/introduction#endpoint-exceptions.

### Read-Only

- `custom_origin_server` (String) CNAME target for the custom hostname. Point `custom_hostname` at this value.
- `hostname_id` (String) Identifier of the custom hostname.
- `hostname_status` (String) Status reported for the hostname record.
- `id` (String) Project reference ID. A project has one custom hostname, so this matches `project_ref`.
- `ownership_verification` (Attributes) DNS record that proves ownership of the hostname. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ownership_verification))
- `ssl` (Attributes) Certificate validation details for the custom hostname. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssl))
- `status` (String) Supabase custom hostname setup status: `1_not_started`, `2_initiated`, `3_challenge_verified`, `4_origin_setup_completed`, or `5_services_reconfigured`.
- `verification_errors` (List of String) Errors from the latest hostname verification.

<a id="nestedatt--ownership_verification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ownership_verification`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) DNS record name
- `type` (String) DNS record type
- `value` (String) DNS record value


<a id="nestedatt--ssl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssl`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Certificate status
- `validation_errors` (List of String) Certificate validation error messages
- `validation_records` (Attributes List) DNS TXT records required to issue the certificate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssl--validation_records))

<a id="nestedatt--ssl--validation_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssl.validation_records`

Read-Only:

- `txt_name` (String) TXT record name
- `txt_value` (String) TXT record value

## Behavioral Notes

### One hostname per project

Supabase allows one custom hostname per project. `id` is the project reference. Changing `project_ref` replaces the resource. Changing `custom_hostname` calls [`POST /v1/projects/{ref}/custom-hostname/initialize`](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/v1-update-hostname-config) again.

Create the DNS records from the computed attributes before activation:

- CNAME from `custom_hostname` to `custom_origin_server`
- TXT from `ownership_verification.name` to `ownership_verification.value`
- TXT records in `ssl.validation_records`

### Activation

`activate = true` calls [`POST /v1/projects/{ref}/custom-hostname/reverify`](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/v1-verify-dns-config) and then [`POST /v1/projects/{ref}/custom-hostname/activate`](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/v1-activate-custom-hostname). When reverify already reports `5_services_reconfigured`, activate is skipped.

DNS propagation and certificate issuance can take time (certificate issuance can take up to 30 minutes). While `activate` is true and `status` is not `5_services_reconfigured`, `terraform plan` shows an update. Apply again after DNS is in place. Each apply sends one reverify and, when still required, one activate.

Setting `activate` to false leaves an active hostname in place. Delete the resource to remove it.

### Rate limits

[`initialize`, `reverify`, and `delete`](https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/introduction#endpoint-exceptions) allow 10 requests per minute. Each apply sends at most one request to each of those endpoints. A `429` response includes the limit so the next apply can wait for the window to reset.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Custom hostnames can be imported using the project reference.
#
# - project_ref: Found in the Supabase dashboard under Project Settings -> General,
#   or in the project's URL: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/<project_ref>
#
# A project has one custom hostname. Import leaves activate false. Set
# activate = true in configuration to reverify and activate when status is not
# already 5_services_reconfigured.
terraform import supabase_custom_hostname.example <project_ref>
```
